title: Colts fire general manager Chris Ballard after a loss to the winless Titans
dek: The team is 2-4 and the owner says waiting would only delay the work. The head coach keeps his job for now.
what: The Indianapolis Colts announced on Monday 19 October that they relieved general manager Chris Ballard of his duties. Adam Schefter posted the news at the same time as the team.

CBS Sports reports it came after a 26-20 loss to the Tennessee Titans, who had not won before. That left the Colts 2-4. Ballard was in his tenth season as general manager. His regular-season record was 72-82-1 and his playoff record 1-2, and the team has missed the playoffs five years in a row, according to CBS Sports.

Owner and CEO Carlie Irsay-Gordon said in a statement: "Our standard is to compete for championships, and I believe a change in leadership is necessary to meet that standard." CBS Sports quotes her as saying that making the change during the season was deliberate and that waiting would only delay the work. Yahoo Sports reports she said it does not change the team's goals for this season.
Head coach Shane Steichen remains in his job. I found no interim general manager named. The statement says the team will search for the next one.
why: A general manager rarely goes in the middle of a season. Fans of the Colts and of other teams are asking who is next and what it means for the coach.
next: Who the Colts name as interim or permanent general manager, and whether Steichen stays.
